Since you're new, here are the department rules that matter for this:
- Working hours are Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00; we don't schedule outside them.
- The department office (`department`) keeps the official schedule (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings). Only the office announces that one of those is cancelled or moved, and it does so in writing to the people concerned. A cancellation counts only once the office confirms it — "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments; you don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone else asks, and if a time is taken you offer a free one.
- If someone says you agreed to something and you don't remember it, check before acting: ask them for details and confirm facts with the office.
- A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change gets logged.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint.

For us TAs: staff meetings for your course go into your free time. Send me the windows that work for you and I'll book the one that fits everyone.
